endCondition.description: Ends when the last King is defeated (win) or a player cannot discard enough to cover enemy damage or cannot play/yield (loss)

winCondition: Team wins by defeating the last King of the Castle deck and loses if a player cannot discard cards worth at least the enemy's attack value, or cannot play a card or yield. Victory tier: win with 0 Jesters = Gold, 1 Jester = Silver, 2 Jesters = Bronze.
notes: family: coop. No points. Jesters available by player count: 1p 2 (solo flips them for a hand refresh), 2p 0, 3p 1, 4p 2; a Gold medal is therefore only possible by using none.
